mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inventory_item WHERE character_id = #{characterId}::uuid ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT * FROM inventory_item WHERE character_id = #{characterId}::uuid AND item_type = #{itemType}::item_type ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_item WHERE character_id = #{characterId}::uuid AND item_type = #{itemType}::item_type
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM inventory_item WHERE character_id = #{characterId}::uuid AND item_type = #{itemType}::item_type

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM inventory_item WHERE character_id = #{characterId}::uuid AND item_type = 'PERMANENT'::item_type AND adventure_entry_id IS NULL AND adventure_gained_item_id IS NULL
SELECT * FROM inventory_item WHERE adventure_gained_item_id = #{gainedItemId}::uuid LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_item ( id, character_id, adventure_entry_id, adventure_gained_item_id, item_name, item_type, rarity, requires_attunement, quantity, acquisition_source, needs_details, source, notes, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{characterId}::uuid, CAST(#{adventureEntryId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), CAST(#{adventureGainedItemId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{itemName}, #{itemType}::item_type, CAST(#{rarity, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS item_rarity), COALESCE(#{requiresAttunement}, false), #{quantity}, #{acquisitionSource}, COALESCE(#{needsDetails}, false), #{source}, #{notes}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_item SET adventure_entry_id = CAST(#{adventureEntryId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), adventure_gained_item_id = CAST(#{adventureGainedItemId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), item_name = #{itemName}, item_type = #{itemType}::item_type, rarity = CAST(#{rarity, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS item_rarity), requires_attunement = COALESCE(#{requiresAttunement}, false), quantity = #{quantity}, acquisition_source = #{acquisitionSource}, needs_details = COALESCE(#{needsDetails}, false), source = #{source}, notes = #{notes}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
